text: Cole is the artist I like.

speaker: A
name: Alex
text: His personality — I think he's honest, kind, and thoughtful.

speaker: A
name: Alex
text: His songs carry so many deep thoughts from his own experience, and he thinks about a lot of things, extracts his thoughts, and passes them on to educate other people — to give the audience power to live on, to live a good life.

speaker: A
name: Alex
text: And why do I like him?

speaker: A
name: Alex
text: Well, first, his songs are amazing — they have rhythm, you can just move your body to them.

speaker: A
name: Alex
text: And you can learn a lot from his lyrics: they give you power, help you handle stress, live a better life, and have the energy to become whoever you want to be.
